subject: Re: Lockbox unapplied payments & VAT retagging — clearance plan
messages:
From: Diane Lawson <diane.lawson@horizoncloud.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: billing@horizoncloud.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Unapplied lockbox payments and VAT tags - Nov batch

Hi Rishi,

We noticed several payments from our Nov 10 lockbox run posted to Redwood but did not apply to open invoices — and the VAT tag didn’t flow through for a subset (EMEA customers). Our AR aging shows three unapplied receipts (total $72,400) sitting in the suspense account.

Attached: horizon_remit_nov10.pdf (remittance summary), lockbox_20261110.csv (raw lockbox extract).

Can your team triage and advise:
- Which payments can be auto-applied vs require manual matching?
- How the VAT tagging will be corrected (we'd like the VAT treatment preserved for our EMEA entity).

Happy to jump on a quick call if useful.

Thanks,
Diane Lawson
Head of Revenue Operations
HorizonCloud
From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Diane Lawson <diane.lawson@horizoncloud.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unapplied lockbox payments and VAT tags - Nov batch

Hi Diane — thanks for the files and the heads up. We're looking into this. A few quick asks so we can scope the fix:

- Can you confirm the lockbox ID/bank reference used on Nov 10 (should match the CSV column "deposit_ref")?
- Which customer entity should keep the VAT tag? You mentioned EMEA — please confirm whether the three unapplied receipts are all EMEA accounts.

Next steps from our side:
1) Finance ops will attempt an auto-match run (rules: remit amount within 1% of invoice + invoice id parse).
2) For leftovers, we'll prepare a manual allocation template and a small set of journal corrections to move amounts out of suspense and into the correct AR buckets with proper VAT codes.

Looping in Grace and Marcus to coordinate the journal entries and ledger mapping. Grace — can you take point on the journal plan? Marcus — you'll own VAT tag mapping and ledger dimension changes.

I can provide a temporary hold on collection notifications while we clear these.

-Rishi
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: grace.oconnor@redwood.com <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Unapplied lockbox payments and VAT tags - Nov batch

On Sun, Nov 15, 2026 at 10:03 AM rishi.malhotra@redwood.com wrote:
> Looping in Grace and Marcus to coordinate the journal entries and ledger mapping.

Thanks Rishi. Quick operational plan proposal:

- Ingest the lockbox CSV into the AR staging bucket and run rule-based auto-match (2 hour job).
- For unmatched receipts (est. 3 rows from Diane): create manual allocation file for AR clerks (template attached in my reply).
- For VAT: Marcus to map each transaction to the correct VAT code and ledger entity, then we run two journal entries: (A) reverse suspense posting; (B) apply receipts to invoices with VAT re-tag header.
- Timing: I propose the journal entries run on Monday 11/22 during the 10:00–11:00 PST maintenance window to minimize downstream impact.

Marcus — please confirm the mapping table you'll use and whether we need a one-off GL code for the reversal. Laura, can you schedule the maintenance window with Platform?

Grace O'Connor
Sr. Accounting Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Diane Lawson <diane.lawson@horizoncloud.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: billing@horizoncloud.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unapplied lockbox payments and VAT tags - Nov batch

Hi Rishi / Grace — attached are the CSV and a short note explaining the three problem payments: two are EMEA subscriptions (cust IDs HC-EMEA-204, HC-EMEA-213) where the remitter left the VAT field blank; one is a US regional credit (cust ID HC-US-117) that should have applied to invoice INV-9901 but appears split across two partial postings.

Attachments: lockbox_20261110.csv, VAT_recon_sheet_Q3.xlsx

We confirm lockbox deposit_ref = LBK-20261110-07. Please proceed with the plan and let us know if you need a signed authorization for journal updates.

Best,
Diane
From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Diane Lawson <diane.lawson@horizoncloud.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lockbox unapplied payments & VAT retagging — clearance plan

Thanks Diane — confirmed receipt of the CSV and recon sheet. Plan below (will execute during Monday maintenance window 11/22 10:00–11:00 PST):

1) Auto-match pass (completed): matched 28 of 31 payments. Remaining 3 moved to manual allocation file (attached: planned_journal_entries_20261122.csv).
2) VAT mapping (Marcus): apply VAT code EMEA-20 to HC-EMEA-204 and HC-EMEA-213. We'll re-tag the posted receipt lines and preserve your original remittance metadata.
3) Split allocation (Laura): for HC-US-117, we will create a single apply to INV-9901 and create a small adjustment to reallocate the stray posting back to the invoice (J/E # JRN-ACCT-4857-A).
4) Journal entries: two JEs to run during the window — reversal from suspense -> AR; then apply receipts to invoices with VAT tag. All JEs will include a reference to HorizonCloud remittance LBK-20261110-07.
5) Post-run validation: we'll send a short report (sample rows + before/after balances) within 2 hours after window close.

Please confirm you approve the journals (this email is sufficient authorization). If you need DocuSign, let me know and we'll route.

Attachments: planned_journal_entries_20261122.csv, VAT_recon_sheet_Q3.xlsx

Thanks — we'll update the JIRA once complete (JIRA-ACCT-4857).

-Rishi Malhotra
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
